beats.title: Kenzo Enters the Dreamworld
beats.boundaryReason: Candrosa wakes Kenzo before dawn, reveals their linked visions, sends him through the Dreamweaver Staff, and asks the party to remain for the coming council.
dateEvidence: The session manifest begins on 1748-03-30, and u0004-u0022 place this scene in the predawn hours through sunrise.
At u0308 the narration resets to the party's return to Karawa and their morning gathering, ending the private scene.

beats.title: Breakfast and the Awakened Soul
beats.boundaryReason: The party reads Candrosa's letter over breakfast, climbs the mesa to find Kenzo, and discusses his vision, the Awakened Soul, magic, and the gods.
dateEvidence: At u0311-u0317 the party wakes and gathers for breakfast on the morning following the predawn scene.
At u0444 the party reaches Kenzo around nine in the morning.

beats.title: Raven's Hold Revealed
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby recounts Ander's encounter with a chanting presence and grasping vine at Raven's Hold, prompting the party to consider its next investigations and festival plans.
dateEvidence: This story follows directly from the party's morning conversation with Kenzo without a time or day transition.
At u1001 the DM explicitly moves the action to that afternoon.

beats.title: Jasu's Spearpoints and Seeker's Net
beats.boundaryReason: At Jasu's workshop, the party examines Arcus's silvered spearpoints, asks about the vanished explorer, and commissions Seeker's chain throwing net.
dateEvidence: At u1001 the DM places the visit that afternoon, still on the session manifest's opening date.
At u1348-u1351 the narration advances into the following day, ending the workshop scene.

beats.title: Gifts, Rumors, and Staff Dancing
beats.boundaryReason: A multi-day festival montage brings the party gifts and rumors before Kenzo dominates the staff-dancing competition and Seeker records his victory in sequential drawings.
dateEvidence: At u1351 the DM advances to the next morning after 1748-03-30, establishing 1748-03-31.
At u1448 the DM frames the following material as highlights from the next three days; the established session timeline places Kenzo's staff-dancing victory on 1748-04-02.
At u1659 the party is back at Ikram's at the end of the competition day.

beats.title: Rumors Before the Axebeak Race
beats.boundaryReason: Back at Ikram's after the staff contest, Delwath shares rumors about travelers, ruins, and divine unease while the party prepares for the next day's axebeak competition.
dateEvidence: At u1659 the party reconvenes at Ikram's at the end of the staff-dancing day.
At u1797 the party sleeps, and u1810 begins the next morning's axebeak competition.

beats.title: The Axebeak Riding Contest
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby survives a bloody but impressive axebeak ride, Kenzo fares worse, and the returning scouts arrive in time for the riding events and tomorrow's council.
dateEvidence: At u1810-u1826 the DM explicitly begins the morning of the axebeak competition after the prior night's sleep.
At u2063-u2066 the party learns that the council will meet tomorrow, establishing the next day transition.

beats.title: Scout Reports Divide the Council
beats.boundaryReason: The party enters the morning council, hears Havdar and Alesh report the gnoll threat, and listens as the leaders divide among attack, aid, defense, and flight.
dateEvidence: At u2067 the party wakes the morning after the 1748-04-03 riding contest.
At u2074 the council is scheduled for ten o'clock, and u2112 begins the meeting.

beats.title: Weighing Karawa's Options
beats.boundaryReason: Asked to break the impasse, the party questions the council about evacuation, defense, Arcus, Raven's Hold, available forces, and the region's geography.
dateEvidence: This deliberation continues directly within the same ten-o'clock council meeting on 1748-04-04.
At u2603 Seeker shifts from information gathering to a concrete fortification proposal.

beats.title: Kenzo's Evacuation Plan
beats.boundaryReason: Seeker maps defenses and moving forces while Kenzo argues that Havdar should escort Karawa's people west before returning to support a later counterattack.
dateEvidence: This planning follows without interruption during the morning council meeting on 1748-04-04.
At u2904 Havdar accepts the central escort proposal, ending the plan's formation.

beats.title: The Council Reaches Accord
beats.boundaryReason: The council agrees to evacuate Karawa, fortify Shakun's temple, seek the Samraat's army, scout south, and send the party north toward Raven's Hold.
dateEvidence: This is the conclusion of the same morning council meeting on 1748-04-04.
At u3125-u3138 Kisa declares the council decided and assigns departures after the festival before the session closes.
